life I'm not saying that I'm extremely rich or anything like that but I do genuinely enjoy my life and I came from a place where that almost seemed impossible I had no money I was depressed I was unhappy I was unhealthy and I genuinely hated life up until around my late teenage years so if I was 14 I would have literally paid to have this video cuz you're essentially going to be skipping all the BS that I had to go through so these are my four 14 pieces of wisdom that I think every teenage guy should know and this is going to go in order from least to most important advice which means that each topic is going to get a little bit deeper than the last number one is going to be knowing your value this has a lot to do with your first relationship I know that in my first relationship with my first girlfriend I didn't even see my own value in myself it was so bad that I actually valued her more than I valued myself and that's something that you never want not only in a romantic relationship but also with any of your friends or any person in the world you need to put yourself first so the question is how do you know your own value and how do you actually put yourself first well the thing is and this is going to suck to hear but most of us are born without value especially as a guy you have to build your own value and the way to do that is by in my opinion having good everybody who watches this video you might want to Value money you might value cars you might value women but some people might just value getting good grades in school the issue is that knowing your value comes with action it's not something that's just there and the action that you need to take is very simple it's just striving to be the best version of yourself tip number two I could have put this a lot later in the video considering how important it is but it is a non-negotiable thing that us teenagers need to do and need to prioritize and what that is is to quit consuming useless content useless content in my eyes is anything where you walk away and you have no value and I guarantee you right now whether you're scrolling on YouTube Instagram Tik Tok Snapchat you probably can't point number three you need to prioritize yourself it is not selfish I remember in high school I was such a people pleaser I would always say yes to everybody when people would ask me to go out or go
